title: Training-free motion statistics match self-supervised behavior encoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.24792v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised encoders for animal behavior are often trained on, or fed, hand-built movement features. We ask whether they beat those ingredients when compared fairly. A training-free representation, made of generic per-frame measurements summarized over fixed time windows and reduced with PCA, is compared with retrained and released encoders (BAMS, hBehaveMAE) under a preregistered protocol: frozen representations of equal size and one shared classifier. On CalMS21 it reaches 85.8 macro F1 against 82.4 for the best encoder, ties with four labelled videos, and leads when the annotator changes or new behaviors must be learned from a few videos; the reading holds for encoders retrained with three seeds. On the MABe22 mouse triplets it scores 83.7 against 80.3 for the released hBehaveMAE (gap +3.4, 95% interval +2.1 to +4.7). On a second species, the MABe22 fly groups, the same recipe scores 51.6 mean F1 over 50 tasks against 48.2 for B

translated_title: 免训练的运动统计特征匹敌自监督行为编码器
translated_abstract: 动物行为的自监督编码器通常在人工构建的运动特征上进行训练，或以这些特征作为输入。我们提出疑问：在公平比较的条件下，这些编码器是否能胜过这类人工特征。我们构建了一种免训练的表示方法，它由通用的逐帧测量指标组成，在固定时间窗口上进行汇总，并通过PCA降维。在预注册协议下（即使用相同大小的冻结表示和一个共享分类器），我们将其与重新训练及已发布的编码器（BAMS、hBehaveMAE）进行了比较。在CalMS21数据集上，该方法达到85.8的宏平均F1分数，而最佳编码器为82.4；在仅有四个标注视频时两者打平，而当标注者更换或需要从少量视频中学习新行为时，该方法保持领先；这一结论在以三个随机种子重新训练编码器的情况下依然成立。在MABe22小鼠三联体数据集上，该方法得分为83.7，而已发布的hBehaveMAE为80.3（差距+3.4，95%置信区间+2.1至+4.7）。在第二个物种——MABe22果蝇群体数据集上，同样的方法在50个任务上取得51.6的平均F1分数，而BAMS为48.2（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文证明了一种免训练的简单运动统计表示（逐帧通用测量+固定时间窗口汇总+PCA降维）在预注册的公平比较协议下，在多个行为识别基准上超越或匹敌最先进的自监督行为编码器，表明自监督编码器并未真正胜过简单的人工特征。
en_tdlr: A training-free representation built from generic per-frame motion statistics, summarized over fixed time windows and reduced with PCA, matches or beats state-of-the-art self-supervised behavior encoders (BAMS, hBehaveMAE) across multiple benchmarks under a preregistered, fair comparison protocol.
